description: Audit every repo under an org root (each immediate subdirectory that carries workflows is one repo) and report pin drift across the org: every action that is used at different refs in different repos, naming each ref and the repos that use it. The org verdict is the worst per-repo verdict; drift itself does not change the verdict.

path.description: Org root: a directory whose immediate subdirectories are repo checkouts

name: audit_org
